title: A tab with nothing left in it closes itself
body:
When the last client in a tab leaves, `Layout::remove` keeps the tab's last pane as an empty pane. The tab then stays until someone closes it from the palette with Close tab. Jack wants a tab to close when its panes are closed, as the usual way to close one.

## Proposal

After `remove_pane` takes a pane out, decade checks the tab. If no pane in it has a client or a running program, and none is pinned or the scratch pane, decade marks the tab closing and `finish_closing` removes it. The workspace's only tab stays with its empty pane, where Enter starts a new terminal.

## Rejected

An x on each tab button in the top bar. The palette's Close tab stays the one explicit way to close a tab.
